description: Election Commission - A member of the Colombo Municipal Council and a member  of the Kotapola Pradeshiya Sabha have Vacated their Office of member
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance declaring that specific individuals have vacated their offices as members of local government councils (Colombo Municipal Council and Kotapola Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in their respective political parties. This directly relates to electoral processes and changes in elected positions, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) which covers electoral matters including vacating offices and changes in membership of elected bodies.
